nodes.name: mvnw.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows Maven Wrapper launcher that bridges a batch entry section into embedded PowerShell to locate, download, validate, and execute the configured Maven distribution.
nodes.languageNotes: Hybrid batch and PowerShell wrapper script generated by Maven Wrapper, using a batch prologue to invoke the embedded PowerShell body.

nodes.name: end batch begin powershell
nodes.summary: Batch label marker that terminates the command-shell prologue and starts the embedded PowerShell implementation used by the Maven Wrapper.

nodes.name: pom.xml
nodes.summary: Maven build descriptor for the Ladux Spring Boot backend, targeting Java 21 and declaring web, JPA, PostgreSQL, Redis, Flyway, JWT, OpenAPI, ShedLock, actuator, validation, and test dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Spring Boot starter parent management with explicit versions for Lombok, Jackson, JWT, ShedLock, Bucket4j, Springdoc, and Testcontainers BOM management.

nodes.name: test-admin.ps1
nodes.summary: PowerShell smoke-test script that logs in as an admin, exercises brand, category, product, and coupon admin API workflows, checks negative authorization and validation cases, then cleans up created records.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Invoke-RestMethod with bearer authorization and a reusable Step wrapper to count passes and failures across API calls.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: Runs a named script block, records pass or fail counts, prints diagnostic output, and extracts response bodies from failed HTTP calls when available.
